situations.title: 소변량·크레아티닌 추세 사정
situations.tagline: His pee output has really dropped — does that mean his kidneys are failing?
situations.brief: AKI 단계 판단을 위해 소변량과 크레아티닌 추세를 사정하세요.
keyPhrases: We track his urine output every hour to watch his kidneys.
A rising creatinine tells us the kidneys are under stress.
These trends help us stage his kidney injury and respond early.

situations.title: 수분·전해질 균형 기록
situations.tagline: Why do you weigh her every day and write down everything she drinks?
situations.brief: I/O와 체중으로 수분·전해질 균형을 정확히 기록하세요.
keyPhrases: Daily weights show us if she's holding on to extra fluid.
We measure everything in and out to balance her fluids.
This helps us protect her kidneys and her heart.

situations.title: 신독성 약물 검토
situations.tagline: He takes ibuprofen at home a lot — could his medicines be hurting his kidneys?
situations.brief: 용량 조정 인지를 위해 신독성 약물을 검토하세요.
keyPhrases: Some medications, like certain pain relievers, can stress the kidneys.
We're reviewing his list and adjusting doses for his kidney function.
We'll avoid drugs that could make the injury worse.

situations.title: CRRT 개념·목적 이해
situations.tagline: What exactly is this continuous dialysis, and how is it different from regular dialysis?
situations.brief: 지속 신대체의 개념과 목적을 가족에게 이해시키세요.
keyPhrases: CRRT is a slow, continuous way to do the kidneys' job.
It's gentler on the blood pressure than regular dialysis.
It removes extra fluid and waste around the clock while he heals.

situations.title: CRRT 회로·접근 관찰
situations.tagline: There are so many tubes and lines — what are all of these doing?
situations.brief: 카테터와 회로를 관찰하며 CRRT 접근 상태를 확인하세요.
keyPhrases: This large catheter carries his blood to and from the machine.
The lines run his blood through a filter that cleans it.
I watch these closely to keep the circuit working safely.

situations.title: 항응고 기초 감시
situations.tagline: The machine keeps his blood from clotting — doesn't that make him bleed?
situations.brief: 회로 응고 예방을 위해 항응고를 기초적으로 감시하세요.
keyPhrases: We use a small amount of blood thinner to keep the filter from clotting.
I watch closely for any signs of bleeding while it runs.
We balance preventing clots with keeping him safe.

situations.title: CRRT 처방 파라미터 이해
situations.tagline: Can you walk me through this patient's CRRT settings before I take over?
situations.brief: 유량·투석액·제거목표 등 CRRT 처방 파라미터를 이해하세요.
keyPhrases: Let's review the blood flow rate and dialysate settings.
His net fluid removal goal is set per hour.
I'll confirm the prescription matches the current orders.

situations.title: 시간당 초여과량 적정
situations.tagline: His pressure dips whenever we pull fluid too fast — should we ease the rate?
situations.brief: 혈역학 균형을 위해 시간당 초여과량을 적정하게 조절하세요.
keyPhrases: His pressure drops when we remove fluid too quickly.
Let's lower the hourly removal rate to keep him stable.
We balance fluid goals with his blood pressure.

situations.title: 시트르산 항응고 대사 감시
situations.tagline: The citrate is keeping the circuit open, but let's check his calcium ratio.
situations.brief: Ca 비율과 산염기를 통해 시트르산 항응고 대사를 감시하세요.
keyPhrases: We monitor the systemic and circuit calcium ratio closely.
Watch for signs of citrate accumulation in his acid-base status.
Let's adjust the calcium and citrate per protocol.
goals: Ca 비율과 산염기 이상을 조기에 조정한다

situations.title: K·PO4 전해질 보정 연계
situations.tagline: His potassium and phosphate are dropping on CRRT — should we start replacing them?
situations.brief: CRRT 중 변동하는 K·PO4 전해질 보정을 연계하세요.
keyPhrases: CRRT can remove potassium and phosphate, so they drop over time.
Let's replace them per protocol to prevent problems.
I'll recheck the levels after we adjust.

situations.title: 회로 응고·압력 경보 대응
situations.tagline: The machine is alarming for high pressure again — is the filter clotting?
situations.brief: filter clotting을 감별해 회로 응고와 압력 경보에 대응하세요.
keyPhrases: The rising pressure suggests the filter may be clotting.
Let's check the access, return, and filter pressures.
We'll flush or plan a circuit change to minimize downtime.

situations.title: 저혈압 동반 CRRT 관리
situations.tagline: His pressure is borderline and he's still on pressors — can he tolerate CRRT?
situations.brief: 승압과 제거 균형을 맞춰 저혈압 동반 CRRT를 관리하세요.
keyPhrases: His pressure is fragile, so we'll minimize fluid removal for now.
Let's coordinate the pressor support with the CRRT settings.
We may pause net removal if his pressure drops further.

situations.title: 간헐 투석과 방식 비교 판단
situations.tagline: Why are we doing continuous dialysis instead of the regular kind for him?
situations.brief: 방식 선택 소통을 위해 간헐 투석과 CRRT를 비교 판단하세요.
keyPhrases: Continuous dialysis is gentler when the blood pressure is unstable.
Regular dialysis is faster but harder on a critically ill patient.
The team chose CRRT to support him more safely right now.

situations.title: 약물 투석 청소 고려
situations.tagline: Does the dialysis wash out his antibiotics — will he still get enough?
situations.brief: 항생제 용량을 고려해 약물의 투석 청소를 판단하세요.
keyPhrases: CRRT can remove some drugs, including certain antibiotics.
Let's confirm the renal dosing for a patient on continuous dialysis.
We'll adjust timing so levels stay effective.

situations.title: CRRT 중 저체온·영양 손실 관리
situations.tagline: He feels so cold on this machine — and is he getting enough nutrition?
situations.brief: 부수효과 대응으로 CRRT 중 저체온과 영양 손실을 관리하세요.
keyPhrases: The machine can cool his blood, so we use a warmer and blankets.
CRRT removes some nutrients, so we adjust his feeding.
We watch his temperature and nutrition closely during treatment.

situations.title: 고칼륨혈증 응급 CRRT 연계
situations.tagline: 환자는 생명을 위협하는 고칼륨혈증으로 심전도 변화가 나타나 응급 CRRT 연계가 시급하다.
situations.brief: 생명위협 고칼륨혈증을 교정하기 위해 응급 CRRT를 신속히 연계하세요.
keyPhrases: His potassium is critically high with ECG changes.
Let's give calcium to protect the heart while we prepare CRRT.
I'll coordinate emergent dialysis to remove the potassium.
goals: 응급 CRRT 연계와 심장 보호 조치를 시행한다

situations.title: 회로 응고·실혈 위기
situations.tagline: 환자는 CRRT 회로가 완전히 응고되어 회로 내 혈액 손실과 치료 중단이 발생한 위기 상황이다.
situations.brief: 실혈과 회로 교체에 대응해 회로 응고 위기를 관리하세요.
keyPhrases: The circuit clotted, and we lost the blood inside it.
Let's assess his hemoglobin and prepare a new circuit fast.
We'll restart CRRT quickly to limit downtime.

situations.title: 시트르산 축적 위기
situations.tagline: 환자는 시트르산 축적으로 대사 알칼리증과 저칼슘혈증이 진행되어 즉각적 조정이 필요하다.
situations.brief: 대사 알칼리증과 저Ca를 조정해 시트르산 축적 위기에 대응하세요.
keyPhrases: The rising total-to-ionized calcium ratio suggests citrate accumulation.
He's developing metabolic alkalosis and low ionized calcium.
Let's reduce citrate and give calcium per the protocol now.

situations.title: 급성 폐부종 응급 초여과
situations.tagline: 환자는 용량과부하로 급성 폐부종이 발생해 호흡곤란이 심해져 응급 초여과가 시급하다.
situations.brief: 용량과부하 위기에서 급성 폐부종에 대한 응급 초여과를 시행하세요.
keyPhrases: He's in fluid overload with acute pulmonary edema.
We need urgent fluid removal to relieve his breathing.
Let's increase net ultrafiltration while watching his pressure.

situations.title: 카테터 관련 대량출혈·감염 위기
situations.tagline: 환자는 투석 카테터 부위에서 대량 출혈과 감염 징후가 나타나 즉각적 대응이 필요하다.
situations.brief: 접근 합병증으로 발생한 카테터 관련 대량출혈과 감염 위기에 대응하세요.
keyPhrases: The dialysis catheter site is bleeding heavily.
Let's apply firm pressure and assess for infection signs.
We may need to hold CRRT and call for line evaluation.

situations.title: 신대체 지속 여부 목표 논의
situations.tagline: He's been on this machine for weeks — will his kidneys ever recover, or are we just prolonging things?
situations.brief: 회복 가능성과 EOL을 고려해 신대체 지속 여부를 가족과 논의하세요.
keyPhrases: We understand how hard it is to see him on the machine this long.
The team can share what recovery might realistically look like.
Let's talk about what he would want and set goals together.
